invariant: Every workspace process and descendant remains inside its effective aggregate resource budget. Exhaustion cannot widen authority or produce a false durable acknowledgement.
required: Define workspace and application budgets for aggregate memory, processes, CPU, storage, and competing I/O.
Derive effective application budgets from workspace policy, launching actor authority, and requested profile.
Apply limits before releasing held application startup. Keep resource-control paths and descriptors outside the application.
Account for project files, Git objects, application state, cache, temporary files, and trash within bounded workspace storage.
Verify inheritance after fork, exec, detachment, and broker recovery.
Verify independent applications and workspaces retain usable authority after another exhausts its budget.
Use independent bounded exhaustion and escape witnesses on both hosts in Debug and runtime sanitizers.
Qualify issuer availability and safe recovery under bounded competing writes. Preserve durable commit ordering.
Run the complete M03 phase gate after focused implementation checks pass.
known_limitations: Existing setrlimit controls are per process and do not establish aggregate workspace or application budgets.
The root ext4 filesystem does not currently advertise project quotas. Do not claim storage quotas exist.
Only cpu, memory, and pids delegation has been verified. Check I/O controller support before selecting enforcement.
A five-second client passed one bounded write-pressure trial. This does not establish worst-case latency.
Moving database work to a worker does not make durable commits complete faster or authorize stale authority decisions.
remaining: Select the aggregate resource and bounded storage design from verified host capabilities.
Implement one coherent enforcement boundary and its independent regression witnesses.
